content.rendered: For those students who were absent or need their school picture retaken, Dorian will be at Archer Glen on Tuesday, December 2nd, to take school pictures. To order pictures, please go to mydorian.com and place your order online. For retakes, please have your student bring their original school pictures with them to school to give to the photographer.
